title: Studieloopbanen van MAVO-en HAVO-cursisten in het schriftelijk onderwijs 1976-1978
authors: Houtkoop, W., Eck, E. van, Stichting centrum voor onderwijsonderzoek, SCO * Amsterdam (primary investigator)
descriptions: Study-careers in postal secondary education. Motivation, information, expectations / when started study / combination of subjects / support, help / leisure / progress of study / evaluation. Background variables: basic characteristics/ housing situation/ occupation/employment/ income/capital assets/ education/ readership, mass media, and 'cultural' exposure/ organizational membership
